instagram_feed._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
instagram_feed.attention: Bold hero element in upper third — the scroll-stopper. High contrast, vibrant color, or unexpected composition that stands out in a feed of thumbnails
instagram_feed.interest: Middle third shows product in context — lifestyle usage, before/after, or detail shot that answers 'what is this?'
instagram_feed.desire: Lower third shows aspirational outcome — the transformed self, the status symbol, the emotional payoff
instagram_feed.action: Bottom 10% reserved for CTA overlay zone — 'Swipe', 'Link in bio', or 'Shop now' — high contrast against background
instagram_feed.safe_zones: Avoid placing critical text in the right 15% (Instagram UI overlay), bottom 20% (caption overlay), top 5% (status bar)
instagram_feed.color_strategy: Brand-dominant palette with one complementary accent for the CTA — 70/20/10 rule (primary/secondary/accent)
instagram_feed.tone: Aspirational but authentic — polished but not sterile, lifestyle-driven

instagram_story._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
instagram_story.attention: Full-bleed hero image, text overlay in top third within 2 seconds of tap — Stories are glanced at for 1-3 seconds
instagram_story.interest: Sticker-poll or question overlay to drive engagement, swipe-up link indicator
instagram_story.desire: Countdown timer, limited-time offer, or exclusive access messaging
instagram_story.action: Bottom 25% reserved for 'Swipe up' or link sticker — must be tappable zone
instagram_story.safe_zones: Top 15% (profile name + timestamp), bottom 25% (link sticker + reply bar), right 10% (report/more)
instagram_story.color_strategy: High contrast for text legibility — dark overlay on bright image or vice versa, minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio
instagram_story.tone: Urgent, exclusive, real-time — behind-the-scenes or flash sale energy

youtube_thumbnail._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
youtube_thumbnail.attention: Emotional face in left or right third at 3x normal size — human faces drive 38% higher CTR. Expression must match video emotion
youtube_thumbnail.interest: Visual contrast between left and right halves — before/after, problem/solution, or unexpected juxtaposition
youtube_thumbnail.desire: Large bold text MAX 5 words in complementary color — readable at 120x68px (mobile thumbnail size)
youtube_thumbnail.action: Arrow, circle, or highlight pointing to the curiosity element — visual finger-pointing
youtube_thumbnail.safe_zones: Bottom 8% (progress bar), bottom-right corner (timestamp), right 15% (YouTube UI)
youtube_thumbnail.color_strategy: Maximum 3 colors — background, text, and one accent. High saturation for small-size visibility. Avoid white backgrounds (blend with YouTube dark mode)
youtube_thumbnail.tone: Clickable energy — excitement, surprise, or intrigue. NOT clickbait — deliver on the promise

linkedin_post._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
linkedin_post.attention: Professional hero image — clean, corporate, aspirational. No stock-photo clichés
linkedin_post.interest: Data visualization, infographic element, or professional context (office, conference, product in use)
linkedin_post.desire: Growth, efficiency, or success metrics implied visually — charts, upward arrows, team collaboration
linkedin_post.action: Minimal — LinkedIn audience prefers value over CTA. Subtle logo placement bottom-right
linkedin_post.safe_zones: Standard banner zones apply. Avoid bottom 10% (article preview overlay)
linkedin_post.color_strategy: Corporate palette — blues, grays, whites. One accent color for data highlight. Professional, restrained
linkedin_post.tone: Authoritative, data-driven, professional. No exclamation marks. Value-first

poster._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
poster.attention: Hero visual occupies 50-60% of poster area — must be visible from 10 feet away (poster is meant to be read across a room)
poster.interest: Headline in largest type — 30% of poster width minimum, readable at 3 meters
poster.desire: Supporting details in clear hierarchy — date, venue, call to action — decreasing type sizes guide the eye down
poster.action: QR code, URL, or contact info in bottom 10% — don't make people search for how to act
poster.safe_zones: Bleed zone: keep critical elements 0.25 inch from edges. Trim zone varies by printer
poster.color_strategy: Limited palette — 2-3 colors maximum for screen printing cost. CMYK conversion for print. High contrast for distance readability
poster.tone: Event-appropriate — formal for conferences, energetic for concerts, informative for educational

ecommerce._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
ecommerce.attention: Product centered, fills 80%+ of frame, pure white background (#FFFFFF) for marketplace compliance (Amazon, Google Shopping)
ecommerce.interest: Product shown from most flattering angle — 3/4 view for 3D objects, flat-lay for flat items, model for wearables
ecommerce.desire: Lifestyle/infographic images as 2nd-6th images in carousel — product in use, size comparison, material detail
ecommerce.action: Price, rating stars, and 'Add to Cart' are handled by the platform UI — image must make product desirable enough to click
ecommerce.safe_zones: Product must not touch edges. 5% margin minimum. No text overlays on main image (marketplace rules)
ecommerce.color_strategy: Pure white background mandatory for main image. Brand colors in secondary images only. Color-accurate product reproduction (returns prevention)
ecommerce.tone: Clean, trustworthy, aspirational. Product is the hero — no distractions

billboard._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
billboard.attention: ONE core message — maximum 7 words. Drivers have 3 seconds to read it at 60mph
billboard.interest: Single powerful image — recognizable from 100+ feet. No complex scenes or fine detail
billboard.desire: Emotional trigger — humor, fear, aspiration, or curiosity. The feeling IS the message
billboard.action: URL or phone number only — no QR codes (nobody stops on a highway). Maximum 1 action element
billboard.safe_zones: All text within center 70% of canvas. 10% bleed for physical installation variance
billboard.color_strategy: High contrast — maximum 3 colors. Warm colors advance (red, orange), cool colors recede (blue, green). Bold sans-serif type only
billboard.tone: Bold, simple, memorable. If you can't read it in 3 seconds, it failed
